questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I ___ (go) to Beijing yesterday.
questions.rubric: 检查不规则动词过去式；用 go 或 goed 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which is the past tense of "eat"?
questions.rubric: 检查不规则过去式记忆；错选可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 旅行时你会带哪件物品？用完整英语句子说明原因。
questions.answer: I take a camera because I want to take photos.
questions.rubric: 检查 because 原因从句结构；句子不完整可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: We should ___ trees. (保护树木)
questions.rubric: 检查环保词汇；拼写错误可标记 spelling_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which one is good for the environment?
questions.rubric: 检查环保行为判断；错选可标记 meaning_confusion。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Long long ago, there ___ a king. (be 动词过去式)
questions.rubric: 检查故事时态与 be 动词过去式；用 is 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 请用英语讲一个你读过的小故事的开头（一句话）。
questions.answer: Once upon a time, there was a clever rabbit.
questions.rubric: 检查故事开头句型；时态混乱可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 信的结尾写"你的朋友"：Your ___
questions.rubric: 检查书信格式；落款错误可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 接电话时，用英语说"你好，我是 Tom"。
questions.rubric: 检查电话英语表达；I am Tom 中式表达可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which word describes a person's height?
questions.rubric: 检查人物描述词汇；错选可标记 meaning_confusion。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 她戴眼镜：She ___ glasses.
questions.rubric: 检查 wear 三单形式；忘加 s 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 你应该多喝水：You ___ drink more water.
questions.rubric: 检查建议句型；should 后动词形式错误可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: "be good at" 的中文意思是？
questions.rubric: 检查能力短语理解；错选可标记 meaning_confusion。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: I have ___ (visit) the Great Wall.
questions.rubric: 检查过去分词；用 visit 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Have you ever seen a panda? 肯定的完整回答是？
questions.rubric: 检查现在完成时回答结构；错选可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Where did you go last summer? 请用过去式写一个完整句子。
questions.answer: I went to Beijing last summer.
questions.rubric: 检查一般过去时不规则动词；用 go 可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 给你的朋友一条健康建议，用 You should... 写一个完整句子。
questions.rubric: 检查 should + 动词原形建议句；结构错误可标记 sentence_pattern_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 邀请朋友去公园，最地道的表达是？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: ______ (Why don’t) you come to my party this Saturday?
questions.rubric: Why don’t you + V 原形；拼写缩写 don’t 可标记 spelling_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 朋友邀请你这周末去看电影，你欣然同意。请写出 2 轮对话（邀请 + 同意 + 追问）。
questions.answer: A: Would you like to see a movie this weekend? B: Sure! That sounds great. What time? A: How about Saturday afternoon at 3?
questions.rubric: 检查 Would you like to + 同意回应 + 时间追问。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Which festival do people eat moon cakes?

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 用 3 句话介绍你最喜欢的一个中国节日（名称 + 时间 + 活动）。
questions.answer: My favorite Chinese festival is the Spring Festival. It is in January or February. We eat dumplings and say happy new year to our family.
questions.rubric: 检查节日拼写 + 时间介词 + 动词搭配。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: “头痛”的英文是？

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: Spell the word “胃痛” → stom_______e
questions.rubric: stomachache 拼写漏 a 可标记 spelling_error。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 校医问：What’s the matter? 你头疼。请写出 2 轮对话（问诊 + 建议）。
questions.answer: Doctor: What’s the matter? Student: I have a headache. Doctor: You should take some medicine and rest.
questions.rubric: 检查 I have a + 病症 + 建议句型 should + V。

questions.subject: english
questions.stem: 朋友说他很累，请用 2-3 句话给出 3 条建议（should / Why don’t you / How about）。
questions.answer: You should take a rest. Why don’t you drink some hot water? How about going to bed early tonight?
questions.rubric: 检查三种建议句型至少用上 2 种。
